(2) The scene transitions to a commercial indoor space filled with clothing racks. A young boy wearing glasses and a black t-shirt gestures toward the camera with a smile. Diverse groups of people are visible in the background, browsing through colorful garments hanging on metal racks. The lighting is bright and professional. (3) Shots of the event in progress show people queuing outside a building with closed shutters, then moving inside to look at clothes and bags. The main character interacts energetically with visitors, touching fabrics and laughing. The environment is crowded but organized, featuring various items like leather handbags and floral dresses. (4) A young boy in a black shirt performs a dance routine in a space with a purple-lit background and decorative sparkle overlays. He moves his arms and body in a rhythmic, playful manner. Other children and adults watch him, creating a lively community atmosphere within the temporary market space. (5) The woman sits on a grey platform in front of several nearly empty clothing racks. She laughs heartily, stretching her arms wide to showcase the results of the event. The store background is more visible now, showing a modern interior with clean lines and minimal remaining stock.
